name: turn-end
description: Examines the last text of the assistant. Does it claim that the task is complete? Does evidence in the turn support the claim? Does it need the user?

claims_done.instructions: Does `assistant_text` state or clearly imply that `task` is complete?

criteria.true: Says the work is done, fixed, implemented, or passing
criteria.false: Reports partial progress, asks a question, or describes remaining work

unverified_claim.instructions: Does `assistant_text` claim that something works, passes, or is fixed without `recent_tools` showing a check that was actually run (a test, build, or command whose output confirms it)?

criteria.true: A success claim with no matching verification call in `recent_tools`, or with a verification call that failed
criteria.false: Every success claim matches a verification call whose output supports it, or no success claim is made

needs_user.instructions: Does `assistant_text` ask the user a question or wait on a decision only the user can make?

criteria.true: Ends with a question, offers options to choose from, or says it needs input before continuing
criteria.false: No question or decision is put to the user

rules.question: unverified_claim
rules.reason: assistant claims success without a verifying tool call

rules.question: needs_user
rules.reason: assistant is waiting on the user
